title: Mixed Event — Secret Distance — Episode7 A Moment of Happiness

meta.Event Outline: In hopes of pulling Kanade out of her songwriting slump, Mizuki plans a mystery tour for a much-needed change of pace. And so begins Nightcord at 25:00's first ever day trip together...

rows.Line: Abandoned School

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That reminds me, if these cherry blossoms are already blooming, that means a new term's about to start...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do you think would happen if we ended up being in the same class?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The same class?
Hmm... That's hard to say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We'd have to do P.E. and stuff together, right? I really can't see us doing that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
P.E...?
I don't like being tired, so I'd rather not...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then I can help you build up some stamina!
Exercising's my forte after all♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I understand that it's good to have stamina, but if it means being tired then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I knew you'd say that! But ask me anytime if you want to learn how to have fun workouts!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And we can ask Mafuyu about any actual schoolwork, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can only show her what the answers are...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great! That's totally fine!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, that completely defeats the point!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do you think our class would be like if we were all together?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena would be late every day...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? I'm right here, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's what came to mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But you'd show up for every art class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She would! Plus, the way she shrugs and grunts and yells, ”This isn't right!” would really get on other people's nerves!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! I don't do that?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, you don't know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? No way, I really do those things...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You forget to mute yourself sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sometimes? She does it fairly often...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: W-Why didn't you say anything?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
But you're working so hard, and I kinda like hearing what you're up to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're one to talk.
I mean, you're always...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whew, I'm spent. We just ended up chatting like always in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did we really need to come all the way out to this creepy place if you knew this would happen...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad we did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I can make our song now too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. All thanks to you showing us around all these places and telling us those stories, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. Your song's gonna include stuff from those stories?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I learned that there are people that couldn't be saved or can't rest in peace, like those sisters from the shrine or the girl from the school...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought about what sort of songs would be able to save each of them and an image popped into my head...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So thank you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm glad I could help...!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I learned that you, Kanade and Ena, were bigger scaredy cats than I realized too, but I'm glad things worked out in the end for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How did being scared help me...? But I guess I can draw some inspiration from those cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Um, are we okay for time...?
I remember someone saying the last bus comes at 5...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
We should go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How were things today, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We went somewhere I normally wouldn't go so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought it was interesting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. That's good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you really feel that way, you could let it show a little more, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena's emotions were on full display.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course they were! This place was unbelievably creepy!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad they all had a good time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I had a lot of fun today too. Especially when I got to see a part of everyone I normally wouldn't.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope we can keep doing stuff like this... Maybe next year we can... Next year...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah! Let's do that!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Today was so much fun that I thought we could do something like this next year...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Next... Year...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Wait, what's going on...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (My chest feels tight... I can't say anything...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I forgot what I was about to say...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Aren't you a little too young for that to start happening?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And the bus is gonna be here any minute. We need to hurry!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, um. Right!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Why wasn't I able to say what I wanted...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
Be right there!
